name: Neutral
about: Plan B, Neutral (toward Claude, 2026): achromatic grays, white page on a #fafafa frame, no borders, soft diffuse shadows. Primitive values only; every plan maps the semantic tokens identically.

notes.neutral: claude.ai --cds-gray (color v2, served 2026-10-25), placed on Atlassian's steps by role as Plan A's are. Text secondary is 60% and primary 90%; dark page and surface-0 is gray-900 #0b0b0b, surface-1 #151515, surface-2 #191919, popover #202020.
notes.alpha: Percent of ink (light) or paper (dark) behind each alpha slot. Slot 300 is the line (color.border): claude.ai draws borders at 8% and lines at 12%.
notes.shadow: Light geometry per layer: [x, y, blur, spread, ink %]. Raised is claude.ai's cards and composer; overlay is claude.ai's menus.
notes.accents: claude.ai's ramps: tints near L .91 with chroma .04-.08 and vivid fills (chroma .16-.19); a violet purple and a grass green. Each family is a hue and a chroma cap on the shared step shape, with the light tints scaled up.
